playoff.entries: 8th vs 3rd of Erovnuli Liga 2, 9th vs 2nd of Erovnuli Liga 2
playoff.note: 10th is relegated directly; both play-off ties are two-legged.

playoff.entries: 2nd and 3rd in Erovnuli Liga 2 vs 9th and 8th in Erovnuli Liga
playoff.note: Winner is promoted directly; runner-up and 3rd go into two-legged play-offs. Last place is relegated to Liga 3.

boundaries.note: 10-club divisions, four meetings each. Liga 2 champion up; 9th and 8th of Liga 1 meet the Liga 2 2nd and 3rd over two legs. 10th of Liga 1 goes down directly, and the Liga 2 last place drops to Liga 3.

notes: Calendar-year league (February-December 2026); '2026-27' is only the dataset label. Both divisions have 10 clubs playing each other four times (36 matches). Erovnuli Liga is branded Crystalbet Erovnuli Liga. Liga 3 exists below Erovnuli Liga 2 but is not in our rows. 2026 movement: Rustavi up as champions, Spaeri and Meshakhte up through the play-offs (beating Gareji and Telavi), Kolkheti down directly.
